title: nan
authors: Haneda M.; Funabora Y.; Doki S.; Doki K.
key_contribution: Presents an adaptive formation control strategy for multi-UAV cooperative relative localization in GNSS-denied environments near structures (e.g. under bridges) to physically avoid multipath regions.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
